√raj2 'color'
present: [4.] rajyati rajyate etc. -- [1.] rañjati etc. E.+ rajati rajate 
[perfect: rarañja rarañje rajyāt arīrajat ararañjat arāṅkṣīt araṅkta raṅkṣīṣṭa raṅkṣyati raṅkṣyate raṅktā ]
verbal: raktá B.+ raktvā raṅktvā -rajya 
secondary: passive: rajyate -- intensive: rā́rajīti -- desiderative: riraṅkṣa- -- causative: rajayati rañjayati etc. E.+ rañjayate 
derivatives: raṅga E.+ rañjaka E.+ -rañjya C. rajaka E.+ rañjana E.+ rañjanīya C. rajana AV.+ rajani E. rajanī E. rajanīya E. rájas? V.+ rají? RV. rajatá V.+ rakti C. rāga U.+ -rāgin E.+ rajayitṛ́ VS. 
The forms with nasal belong to the later language.

√rāj 'be kingly'
present: [1.] rā́jati etc. V.+ rā́jate etc. E.+ -- [2.] rā́ṣṭi rā́ṭ 
perfect: rarāja rejus etc. E.+ rarājatus reje etc. E.+ rarāje 
aorist: [1.] rājyāsam -- [3.] ararājat -- [5.] arājiṣus arājiṣṭa 
[future: rājiṣyati rājitā ]
verbal: rājáse 
secondary: intensive: rāraj- -- desiderative: rirājiṣa- -- causative: rājayati etc. B.+ rājayate etc. 
derivatives: rā́j V.+ -rāja V.+ rā́jan V.+ rāján RV. rājaná B.+ -rājin RV.E. rā́ṣṭrī V.B.S. rāṣṭrá V.+ 
Is most probably an old denominative of rā́j 'ruler', from √ṛj, raj, which see. The anomalous stem irajyá- (see ib.) is related with it.
